dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: Greetings, dear visitor. Are you here to take the boat?

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: It's a folk verse in Chenyu Vale. Every ferryman knows the words.

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: This one is easy to understand. There's another, a more elegant one...

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: "...The spring's cries ripple through the vales, the shrines depart from northeast shores. The heights and shallows in the southwest hide..."

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: I'll sing you this one when you take the raft to Yilong Wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: Chenyu Vale's shallow and has a lot of bends, so big ships would get stranded here all too easy.

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: But not a raft! It's light and sits high on the water, so no bends or unseen reef can stop us.

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: Most importantly, the scenery of Chenyu Vale can only be appreciated in detail from a raft.

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: Alright, we're here! Have a safe journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ride the bamboo raft to Yilong Wharf

dialogues.speaker: Bosu
dialogues.text: All set! Please take your seats and we'll be on our way.
